$comment: Claude attribution is OFF, by user instruction 2026-08-17. Empty strings suppress the commit
trailer and the PR-body footer; sessionUrl:false drops the Claude-Session link that web and
Remote Control sessions otherwise append. This is the supported control for it — the harness
reads these keys, so nothing is left to per-commit discipline.
Harness enforcement for AgentMailKit. The plan's anti-drift rules are prompts until they are
bound here: the model does not decide whether a hook runs.
Hooks complement permissions, CI and branch protection — they replace none of them.
PERMISSIONS PRINCIPLE: the plan is the authority on what is routine. Anything the plan
mandates as normal work — the verify command, the crate write/test loop, committing and
pushing to Gitea, worktree lifecycle — is ALLOWED and must not interrupt the user. Anything
that leaves the repo, spends money, touches production, or could disclose a secret is ASK or
DENY. An allow-list that is too narrow is not 'safe': it trains the user to approve without
reading, which is strictly worse than a correct list.
`sdxd run` is ALLOWED for that reason: it is the only sanctioned way a credential reaches a
command here, it injects by reference and the value is never read, and the conformance harness
needs it as routine work. `sdxd get` — the one form that PRINTS a secret — is DENIED, and deny
outranks allow.
FORGE MIGRATED TO GITHUB 2026-08-17 by explicit user instruction, superseding the global
`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` 'Gitea only, never GitHub/gh' rule for THIS project only. `gh` moved from
deny to allow so the repo can be driven from Claude's cloud sandbox. `gh auth token` and
`gh auth login --with-token` stay DENIED: the first prints a credential to the transcript, the
second takes one on a pipe an agent would have to hold. Authenticating is the user's job, done
interactively via `gh auth login`.
